page_title: TOR 0-0 LEC | Torino v Lecce 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
83' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
82' A pass by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' The game is interrupted now, Saul Coco (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Hamza Rafia (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
74' Here is a change. Duvan Zapata is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Yann Karamoh (Torino).
74' Here comes a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Ilic.
71' Lecce fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
70' Luca Gotti has decided to make a change. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) replaces Tete Morente.
70' A substitution has been made. Medon Berisha goes off and Remi Oudin (Lecce) comes on.
67' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

67' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
62' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Karol Linetty and he is replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
62' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
61' That will be all from Ante Rebic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
59' Borna Sosa (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
57' Torino hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
46' The game is over for Balthazar Pierret. Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Paolo Vanoli decided to make a change. Marcus Pedersen is replaced by Borna Sosa (Torino).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tete Morente (Lecce) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Torino are awarded a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Che Adams (Torino) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
40' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and signals a foul after Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) brought his opponent down.
38' Samuele Ricci (Torino) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
38' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post.
35' Great ball in from Medon Berisha. Tete Morente (Lecce) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
34' Duvan Zapata (Torino) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
29' Saul Coco (Torino) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call.
28' A neat pass is well received by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
27' A cross into the box finds the head of Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) who steers it goalwards, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
24' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
23' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) is booked by the referee.
23' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Balthazar Pierret (Lecce). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Torino.
20' Mergim Vojvoda is being substituted because of an injury. Paolo Vanoli sends Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) on the pitch.
17' A cross from the by-line finds Duvan Zapata (Torino) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
15' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Medon Berisha (Lecce) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.

12' Duvan Zapata (Torino) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
11' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
9' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) takes the pass from Tete Morente in his stride and from mid-range fires in a thunderous shot, but it lacks direction and goes well wide of the left post.
7' Medon Berisha (Lecce) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post.
5' Samuele Ricci (Torino) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
4' Tete Morente (Lecce) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
